pub(crate) fn write_stderr_delimiter(test_output: &mut Vec<u8>, test_name: &TestName) {
    match test_output.last() {
        Some(b'\n') => (),
        Some(_) => test_output.push(b'\n'),
        None => (),
    }
    writeln!(test_output, "---- {test_name} stderr ----").unwrap();
}
